subject: SIG questionnaire — evidence ownership & delivery timeline
messages:
From: Caroline Price <caroline@finlytics.com>
To: logan_wright@redwood.com
Cc: security-ops@finlytics.com
Date: 2027-08-09T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: SIG timeline and evidence ask for Finlytics renewal

Hi Logan,

Hope you’re well — Finlytics’ renewal is coming up and our procurement team flagged the SIG as a gating item. We have a target to have the completed SIG and supporting artifacts uploaded to our secure portal by Aug 20 to keep the timeline for procurement.

Can you confirm who on your side will own:
- answers in the questionnaire (we’ve already started a draft)
- SOC2/attestation evidence (certificate, controls descriptions)
- network and infra diagrams

If you can share an upload plan (who, what, and when) by close of day Tuesday that would help our procurement and security teams plan.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Caroline
Caroline Price
Sr. Procurement Manager, Finlytics
caroline@finlytics.com

From: logan_wright@redwood.com
To: Caroline Price <caroline@finlytics.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-09T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG timeline and evidence ask for Finlytics renewal

Caroline — thanks for the heads up and the deadline. We can meet the Aug 20 portal cutover but will need to split ownership internally to avoid last-minute rush. Proposed plan: 

- Redwood (questionnaire answers): Lauren Bishop (internal SME for product security) — deliver draft by 2027-08-12
- SOC 2 attestation & control narratives: Priyom Das (compliance) — upload scanned cert + narratives by 2027-08-16
- Network/infra diagrams: Logan Wright (me) — finalized diagram and architecture notes by 2027-08-15

I’ll attach check-ins and we’ll post artifacts to the Drive link and the Finlytics portal once everything is signed off internally. If that schedule works, I’ll lock owners and drop a short weekly cadence for any clarifications.

Next steps for today: Lauren, Priyom — can you confirm you own your pieces and confirm whether you need additional inputs from Finlytics (e.g., specific control mappings)?

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: logan_wright@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-10T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG timeline and evidence ask for Finlytics renewal

Sounds good — I’ll take the questionnaire answers. Quick notes:

- I already have a partial draft for the product controls (sections 1–4) and will complete the rest by 2027-08-12 EOD.
- I need the following from Finlytics to map controls properly: evidence of data classification policy and whether they require our internal change-control logs for specific endpoints. Caroline — can you confirm those two items?
- I’ll upload the draft answers to the shared Drive in a folder named /Finlytics/SIG/ for your review and then export the final to the Finlytics portal.

Attachments: redwood_sig_answers_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with section owners and current status)

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Security PM, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: logan_wright@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-12T14:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG timeline and evidence ask for Finlytics renewal

Quick update — SOC2 cert is ready (PDF with seal) but we have two blockers for evidence upload:
1) The network diagram needs a redaction pass to remove internal-only hostnames; I can get you the redaction guidance but need the diagram file from Logan.
2) Our agreement with a third-party monitoring vendor limits sharing of raw change logs; I can produce an authored narrative and redacted excerpts but Caroline, we may need a short AOB note confirming that redacted artifacts are acceptable for your procurement portal.

I’ll aim to place the SOC2 cert and narratives into the Drive by 2027-08-16. Logan — can you send the current diagram (PNG/Visio) for redaction by EOD tomorrow?

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: logan_wright@redwood.com
To: Caroline Price <caroline@finlytics.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, security-ops@finlytics.com
Date: 2027-08-15T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Final evidence upload plan + ask re: redaction acceptance

Caroline — short status update ahead of the portal deadline:

- Questionnaire answers: completed draft uploaded to Drive (/Finlytics/SIG/redwood_sig_answers_v2.xlsx) — Lauren will finalize any wording by tomorrow morning.
- SOC2 cert & control narratives: Priyom will upload the attestation PDF and narratives by 2027-08-16.
- Network diagram: attached for redaction (network-architecture-diagram.png). We removed hostnames and replaced PBX/internal IDs with placeholders; please confirm if that level of redaction is acceptable for your portal.

Attachments: network-architecture-diagram.png (diagram, redacted), redwood_sig_answers_v2.xlsx (draft answers)

If Finlytics can accept the redacted diagram and the authored narrative + redacted excerpts in lieu of raw change logs, we’re on track for the Aug 20 portal deadline. If you need anything else (or want a quick call to walk through redactions), happy to schedule a 20-minute slot.

Thanks — appreciate the partnership.
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147
